items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: He introduced me to Quincy Jones

ctx.x: I didn't want to think so, but I was forced to think so, after that. Freddy and I, we were still great friends, when he came back, in '53 or '54, when he came back with Quincy Jones' orchestra. He was rehearsing a show.
